en.text:
Casting your Empowering Rift with a <void/>Void Super equipped grants <void/>Devour for 11 seconds (17 seconds with <void/>Echo of Persistence), and kills with <void/>Devour active grant you 10% Class Ability energy.

Empowering Rifts cast by you have additional behaviors:
• Standing in the Rift grants you <void/>Devour for 11 seconds (17 seconds with <void/>Echo of Persistence)
• Exiting and re-entering the Rift refreshes the duration of <void/>Devour without needing a kill.

Legacy (Non-Functional) Perk: 
Empowering Rifts you cast grant <overload/>Overload Shot to you and allies. Previously, this allowed non-intrinsic weapons to gain <overload/>Disruption, with the exception that it could not overwrite pre-existing intrinsics.

However, now that <bold all /> weapons have an intrinsic Breaker-type, Secants can no longer overwrite any of them. This breaks the UI in your weapons tray and leaves this portion of the exotic non-functional.
